, Reason for Mistake: The Planner accepted an incorrect search snippet claiming Theudebert I was the son of Theodoric the Great and concluded the final answer without verification. This conflated Theodoric the Great (Ostrogoth) with Theuderic I (Merovingian). Earlier evidence in the first web result already indicated Theuderic I was Theudebert I’s father, so failing to reconcile or confirm sources led to the wrong answer.
